# Real test artifacts

These JSON files are summaries produced by the actual local Worker, ASR models,
and LLM endpoints on 2026-11-10. They are not mocked.

- `environment.json` — machine, versions, device.
- `asr-5m-zh.json` — 5m Chinese speech, Qwen3-ASR-0.6B + aligner.
- `asr-10m-mixed.json` — 10m Chinese/English mixed speech.
- `asr-60m-zh.json` — 63m Chinese long-form speech.
- `cer-5m-zh.json`, `cer-10m-mixed.json` — CER against the exact TTS script.
- `cancel-resume-5m.json` — cancel after 2 chunks, resume, complete.
- `worker-crash-resume.json` — SIGKILL the Worker after 2 chunks, resume.
- `offline-asr.json` — inference with HTTP proxies pointing at a closed port.
- `notes-3b.json` — local Qwen2.5-3B notes in concise/detailed/review modes.
- `dsh-e2e.json` — DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 headless end-to-end runs, including privacy
  guard and hidden content tools.
- `packaged-install.json` — the same worker loaded from a packed tarball.

Audio fixtures are generated by `scripts/generate-test-audio.mjs` using macOS
`say` and are intentionally not committed (`testdata/audio/` is ignored).
They are synthetic speech, not human classroom recordings. See
`docs/test-report.md` for the methodology and limitations.
